partSummaries.partI: Establishes the foundational governance architecture through fractality (scale-invariant patterns) and polycentrism (overlapping jurisdictions with tri-cameral structure).
partSummaries.partII: Explores the economic and ecological metabolism through dual-currency systems, real-time ecological intelligence, and adaptive universal basic income.
partSummaries.partIII: Defines authority distribution through subsidiarity principles and ecosystem guardianship with legal standing for nature.
partSummaries.partIV: Details crisis response mechanisms and the multi-decade transition pathway from current extractive systems to regenerative frameworks.

readingGuide.firstTime: First-time readers should read chapters sequentially as each builds on previous concepts.
readingGuide.reference: Use as reference by consulting individual chapters and appendices as needed.
readingGuide.implementation: For implementation, focus on relevant appendices and chapter integration points.
readingGuide.troubleshooting: When problems arise, consult Appendix B for diagnostic questions and solutions.
